messages:
marta (partnerships): Heads up — the Azure marketplace PO for Nimbus came back rejected. Procurement says the SKU in the PO payload doesn't match the marketplace listing, so it's failing validation (422).
ajay (marketplace): Ugh, is this the customer using the partner-managed SKU or our publisher SKU?
marta (partnerships): Partner-managed. Nimbus asked us to accept their partner SKU mapping. The PO JSON they sent: 
```json
{
  \"po_number\": \"PO-98231\",
  \"items\": [
    {\"sku\": \"NMB-ENTERPRISE-1\", \"qty\": 10, \"unit_price\": 12000}
  ]
}
```
Response from marketplace API: `422 Unprocessable Entity - sku_not_found: \"NMB-ENTERPRISE-1\"`
ajay (marketplace): Marketplace requires that partner SKUs are pre-registered under our publisher account and linked to the offer. Looks like Nimbus never provisioned the alias.
liam (finance): Procurement can't approve without a valid vendor alias on the PO — our accounting system will not accept a PO with a foreign SKU. Is there a quick alias workaround?
kelly (legal): There's also an outstanding redline in the SOW around indemnity. Legal won't sign off on the contract until that is resolved; procurement flagged that as well.
marta (partnerships): Two blockers then: SKU alias and legal redline. Nimbus says they will not update the PO until we accept their existing SKU.
ajay (marketplace): I can open a partner support ticket with Azure contact to add the SKU mapping, but that usually takes 24-48 hours. If we need faster, we can ask Nimbus to resubmit using our canonical SKU: `RW-REDWOOD-PREMIUM`.
liam (finance): If they resubmit with RW-REDWOOD-PREMIUM we'll need a mapping note showing effective pricing to match the PO amount, otherwise tax/proc mismatch flags will fire.
marta (partnerships): I pinged Nimbus: they prefer we add alias on our side. Asking legal to prioritize the indemnity clause too. @kelly any chance to expedite review? :pray:
kelly (legal): I can do an initial review today and propose a compromise clause that meets their security asks. But contract countersign will still need signature.
deploy-bot: ticket created: #AZURE-SUPPORT-5549 — partner SKU alias request queued. ETA 36h.
ajay (marketplace): OK, sync plan: (1) legal will push the indemnity adjustment (kelly), (2) marketplace will request alias (ajay -> AZ support), (3) finance will prepare acceptance notes for RW-REDWOOD-PREMIUM if Nimbus opts to resubmit (liam).
marta (partnerships): Thanks — I'll keep Nimbus queued and ask them to stand by. If AZ support takes longer than 48h we should ask Nimbus to resubmit with our SKU to unblock procurement. :thumbsup:
liam (finance): Noted — if they resubmit, include this snippet in PO to avoid reconciliation issues: `
"pricing_reference": "SOW-2026-05-NIMBUS",
"currency": "USD"
`
ajay (marketplace): Also documenting: action items added to the partner-runbook.
marta (partnerships): Great. I'll follow up here when AZ confirms alias or Nimbus resubmits. Thanks everyone. :v:
